# FRoSTA: business activities and routes to market

**FRoSTA is a frozen-food manufacturer, not a chocolate or cocoa specialist.** I found no disclosed business in cocoa trading, cocoa processing or chocolate manufacturing in its business-model disclosures or the product ranges reviewed. Its disclosed activities cover branded frozen food, private-label manufacturing, foodservice, industrial customers, home-delivery suppliers, direct online sales and associated product-development services. It also sells non-food merchandise. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))

**Scope:** FRoSTA AG and its group businesses, including COPACK and FRoSTA Foodservice. The inventory below covers all externally marketed activities identified in the sources—not every individual recipe or internal support function. I prioritised the company’s **2025 annual financial report**, checked the **2026 half-year report**, and used its corporate, consumer, COPACK and Foodservice websites for channel and product details. The latest full-year report listed is for 2025; the half-year report was published on August 4, 2026. All sources used below are company sources. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/service/publications/download-info/ag-annual-report-2025/))

## 1. FRoSTA-branded frozen food sold through retailers

- **Products:** Frozen ready meals—including meat/poultry, fish, vegetarian and vegan meals—plus frozen fish, vegetables, fruit and herbs. The current German range also includes high-protein meals and premium “à la Carte” pasta meals. These are product lines within the frozen-food business, rather than separate industries. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Direct buyers:** Food retailers; the annual report describes collaboration with the retail trade and supermarket availability. Individual customer names and contractual purchasing arrangements are not comprehensively disclosed. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Ultimate consumers:** Household consumers who prepare and eat the food.
- **How sold:** Primarily supermarket frozen-food departments. FRoSTA also sells directly online, described separately below. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Countries of sale:**
  - **Explicitly named EEA markets:** Germany, Austria, Italy, Poland and Czechia on the corporate “Brand and Sales” page.
  - **Additional country-facing brand websites:** Hungary, Slovakia and Romania. These support the existence of local brand offerings, but do not establish that every product category is sold in each country.
  - **Outside the EEA:** Switzerland is explicitly named.
  - The corporate page also says “other European countries” without naming them. **A complete country-by-country sales list, and a product-category-by-country matrix, are not stated.** ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/company/brand-and-sales/))

## 2. Private-label development and manufacturing — COPACK

- **Products/services:** Development and manufacture of frozen foods under customers’ brands, following their recipe specifications and packaging requirements. The disclosed range includes **ready meals, fish, vegetables, organic frozen products, herbs, fruit and puff-pastry products/snacks**. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/dokumente/half-year-financial-report-2026/?tmstv=1791897592))
- **Direct buyers:** Food retailers and wholesalers commissioning their own-label products. COPACK additionally identifies home-delivery and foodservice businesses as customers; these channels are distinguished below. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/company/brand-and-sales/))
- **Ultimate consumers:** Consumers buying the resulting retailer-brand products; for wholesale customers, the eventual consumers depend on the downstream retail or catering channel.
- **How sold:** Business-to-business manufacturing and supply agreements; customers then sell the products under their own brands. The 2026 half-year report expressly describes manufacture on behalf of retail partners to their specifications. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/dokumente/half-year-financial-report-2026/?tmstv=1791897592))
- **Countries of sale:** The company describes **domestic and international customers** and a **European private-label business**. **A complete list of countries, including individual EEA destinations, is not stated in the reviewed activity disclosures.** German and Polish factory locations should not be treated as a list of sales destinations. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/company/brand-and-sales/))

## 3. Other company-owned frozen-food brands — COPACK

- **Products:** COPACK identifies **tiko, Elbtal, BioFreeze and Balance Mix** as its own brands, produced alongside retailers’ private labels. They let customers supplement frozen-food assortments, test products and run promotional ranges. The cited page does not comprehensively map each brand to its current product categories. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/produktentwicklung/neue-produkte/))
- **Direct buyers:** Trade customers purchasing these branded ranges for their assortments, particularly retail customers.
- **Ultimate consumers:** Shoppers buying the products from those trade customers.
- **How sold:** Through trade customers’ assortments and promotions—not disclosed as a separate chain of company-owned shops. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/produktentwicklung/neue-produkte/))
- **Countries of sale:** **Not stated for these individual brands.** COPACK’s broader European footprint does not establish that each brand is sold throughout Europe. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/produktentwicklung/neue-produkte/))

## 4. Professional foodservice and out-of-home frozen food

- **Products:** Frozen products designed for professional kitchens, including:
  - fish fingers, prepared fish fillets and portion fillets;
  - ready meals, rice/pasta/stir-fry dishes and side dishes;
  - vegetables, conventional and organic;
  - vegetable patties and vegetarian/vegan burgers;
  - plant-based fish and meat substitutes, including vegan fish fingers, fish cakes and schnitzels;
  - herbs, fruit and breakfast products;
  - puff-pastry products;
  - specially developed pasta products from the group’s own fresh-pasta production. ([frostafoodservice.com](https://www.frostafoodservice.com/products/))
- **Direct buyers:** **Specialist wholesalers and cash-and-carry operators** are the purchasing channel expressly identified in the German Foodservice FAQ. The annual report additionally identifies **gastronomy chains and wholesalers** as out-of-home customers; direct chain supply is therefore also disclosed at group level. ([frostafoodservice.de](https://www.frostafoodservice.de/haeufig-gestellte-fragen/))
- **Ultimate consumers:** Restaurant and catering guests; employees and students eating in canteens; children in schools/daycare; hospital patients; and residents of senior-care facilities. These are the user groups FRoSTA identifies, rather than necessarily the party invoiced by FRoSTA. ([frostafoodservice.de](https://www.frostafoodservice.de/))
- **How sold:** Professional B2B distribution through wholesalers/cash-and-carry, plus disclosed chain supply. The German FAQ says the dedicated Foodservice products are **not sold in ordinary retail** and that Foodservice currently has **no online shop**. This is distinct from FRoSTA’s consumer and office-delivery online shop. ([frostafoodservice.de](https://www.frostafoodservice.de/haeufig-gestellte-fragen/))
- **Countries of sale:** **Germany is directly evidenced** by the German operation and dealer channel. The Foodservice site provides a dedicated **Italian website** and a **Polish-language version**, supporting country-facing activity in Italy and Poland. **A complete foodservice sales-country list is not stated**, and language versions alone do not establish the exact assortment or distribution coverage in each market. ([frostafoodservice.de](https://www.frostafoodservice.de/))

## 5. Industrial frozen-food supply

- **Products/services:** FRoSTA acts as a **production partner for industrial customers**, supplying frozen products. Its Foodservice operation also describes an industrial business and tailored product development, including specialised pasta products. **The reviewed sources do not disclose a separate, exhaustive industrial-product catalogue or named industrial customers.** ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Direct buyers:** Industrial customers. Interpreting these as downstream food manufacturers/processors is reasonable in context, but the report itself does not comprehensively identify their business types.
- **Ultimate consumers:** Consumers of the industrial customer’s finished food products or meals; this is a downstream-use inference, not a customer-specific disclosure.
- **How sold:** B2B production-partner supply, rather than direct consumer retail. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Countries of sale:** **Not stated specifically for industrial supply.** The annual report identifies industrial customers within the business but does not provide their destination countries. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))

## 6. Supply to third-party home-delivery businesses

- **Products:** Frozen-food ranges supplied to home-delivery operators. COPACK’s disclosed range includes fish, vegetables, ready meals, organic products, fruit, herbs and puff pastry. **It does not specify which of these categories each home-delivery customer purchases.** ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/en/Product-Range/Overview/))
- **Direct buyers:** Third-party home-delivery businesses—identified as “Heimdienste” in the annual report—not the households receiving their deliveries. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))
- **Ultimate consumers:** Household customers of those delivery businesses.
- **How sold:** FRoSTA/COPACK supplies the delivery operator B2B; the operator subsequently sells and delivers to households. This is distinct from FRoSTA’s own online shop. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/en/Product-Range/Overview/))
- **Countries of sale:** The 2026 half-year report places the home-delivery business in **Europe**. **Individual destination countries, including EEA countries, are not stated.** ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/dokumente/half-year-financial-report-2026/?tmstv=1791897592))

## 7. Direct-to-consumer online frozen-food sales

- **Products:** FRoSTA-branded frozen meals, fish, vegetables and herbs, including vegan, organic, high-protein and premium ranges, sold individually or in product boxes. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/))
- **Direct buyers:** Consumers ordering from FRoSTA’s own online shop.
- **Ultimate consumers:** Those consumers and their households.
- **How sold:** Own e-commerce store with frozen parcel delivery to the customer’s address. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/haeufig-gestellte-fragen/))
- **Countries of sale:** **Germany and Austria**, explicitly stated in the shop FAQ. Both are EEA markets. The FAQ says Austria is the destination served in addition to Germany; it does not advertise wider international shipping. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/haeufig-gestellte-fragen/))

## 8. Direct B2B online office/team meal delivery

- **Products/services:** Frozen meals and “team boxes” ordered for offices, with delivery on a requested date and preparation by the team. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/b2b/))
- **Direct buyers:** Registered businesses/employers ordering for their teams.
- **Ultimate consumers:** Employees/team members.
- **How sold:** Direct through FRoSTA’s B2B online offering, delivered to the office. It is a separate purchasing route from wholesale professional Foodservice. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/b2b/))
- **Countries of sale:** The page advertises **Germany-wide delivery**. **It does not separately state whether the B2B programme serves Austria or other countries.** The consumer shop’s Austrian shipping policy should not automatically be extended to B2B orders. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/b2b/))

## 9. Product development and strategic assortment consulting

- **Services:** COPACK offers product development and strategic advice on assortment planning, market trends, recipe/product concepts, clean-label projects and ingredient traceability. Foodservice also develops products for professional users and offers assortment advice, including on-site consultation. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/copack-private-label/strategische-beratung/))
- **Direct customers:** Retail partners for COPACK consulting; professional foodservice users and wholesalers for Foodservice advice.
- **Ultimate users:** The business customer uses the advice; shoppers or diners ultimately consume the resulting products.
- **How sold/provided:** Through the B2B supplier relationship, direct contact and consultation. **The sources do not say whether consulting is separately charged or bundled with product supply.** ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/copack-private-label/strategische-beratung/))
- **Countries of sale:** **Not separately stated for these services.** They should not be assumed available in every country where frozen products are sold. ([copack.eu](https://www.copack.eu/de/copack-private-label/strategische-beratung/))

## 10. Non-food merchandise

- **Products:** FRoSTA-branded hoodies, socks, slide sandals, shopper bags, insulated frozen-food bags and cooking tongs. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/produkte/merchandise/))
- **Direct buyers:** Consumers and gift buyers.
- **Ultimate users:** Buyers or gift recipients; these goods are used or worn rather than eaten.
- **How sold:** **Exclusively through FRoSTA’s own online shop**, not supermarkets or other shops. Merchandise ships as ordinary parcels, separately from frozen-food orders. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/produkte/merchandise/))
- **Countries of sale:** Offered through the German shop, whose general FAQ names **Germany and Austria** as shipping destinations. **The merchandise page does not state a separate country list or explicitly confirm merchandise-specific Austrian coverage**, so that distinction remains unverified. ([frosta.de](https://www.frosta.de/produkte/merchandise/))

## Important limits on the country inventory

The strongest named-market evidence concerns the **FRoSTA consumer brand** and its **own online shop**. The company does **not** publish a comprehensive activity-by-country matrix for private label, industrial supply, home-delivery suppliers, consulting or its smaller brands in the sources reviewed. Its statement that it operates with employees in seven European countries is an operational footprint—not a complete sales-country list. Likewise, production in Germany and Poland does not imply sales are restricted to those countries. ([frosta-ag.com](https://www.frosta-ag.com/dokumente/jahresfinanzbericht-frosta-konzern-2025-2/?tmstv=1791938771))

Consequently, this is an inventory of **all disclosed commercial activities found**, with explicit gaps—not a claim that every country of sale or every customer relationship is publicly identifiable.
